senses.en: using computers
examples: Students may pursue research in any aspect of [[computational]] linguistics based on their own interest.

senses.en: when sth. begins to be known or noticed
examples: Future research should look at the behavior and ecology of these worms to understand what caused the [[emergence]] of new species.

senses.en: mind and thoughts
examples: The flow of everyday life provides a context in which individual human [[consciousness]] operates.

senses.en: the condition of being awake and able to understand what is happening around you
examples: When the man finally regains [[consciousness]] and walks to a mirror, he is unsure of who he is.

senses.en: based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes or opinions rather than facts
examples: We know that taste in art is a [[subjective]] matter and differs from person to person.

senses.en: a strange habit or feature of sb.'s character, or a strange feature of sth.
examples: She took pride in her children's [[quirks]] and individuality, and made no effort to try to change them.

senses.en: sth. strange that happens by chance
examples: Years later, by a strange [[quirk]] of fate, she found herself sitting next to him on a plane.

senses.en: (esp. BrE) the period of time it takes for sth. to happen or be completed
examples: The [[time-scale]] for completing the work would be fairly tight and we have to work hard.

senses.en: (AmE empathize) be able to understand sb. else's feelings, problems, etc., esp. because you have had similar experiences
examples: My mother died last year so I can really [[empathise]] with what he's going through.

senses.zh: 构思，设想，想出（新的主意、计划等）
senses.en: think of a new idea, plan, etc. and develop it in your mind
examples: Scientists first [[conceived]] the idea of the atomic bomb in the 1930s.

senses.en: v.(fml.) imagine a particular situation or think about sth. in a particular way
examples: Language may be [[conceived]] of as a process which arises from social interaction.

senses.zh: 人工制品，手工艺品（有史学价值的工具、武器等）
senses.en: (esp. BrE) (also artifact esp. AmE) an object such as a tool or weapon that was made in the past and is historically important
examples: The museum is well-known for having many [[artefacts]] dating back to prehistoric times.

senses.zh: （文章、观点等）连贯的，有条理的，一致的
senses.en: if a piece of writing, set of ideas, etc. is coherent, it is easy to understand because it is clear and reasonable
examples: It makes me crazy that the board seems to have no [[coherent]] plan for saving the company.

senses.zh: 难以置信地；不可能真实地
senses.en: in a way that is difficult to believe and therefore unlikely to be true
examples: He argued, somewhat [[implausibly]], that the accident could not have been prevented.

senses.en: the act of forming a wrong understanding of sth. that is said or done, or an example of a wrong understanding
examples: It appears that this universally promoted idea was based on a [[misinterpretation]] of the test results.

senses.en: in the traditional or original way
examples: Consumers are increasingly interested in the [[authentically]] prepared food.

senses.en: much; a lot
examples: Housing conditions in this area have improved [[considerably]] over the past few years.

senses.en: the shape and size of a room, which affect the way sound is heard in it
examples: The auditorium has comfortable seating and modern [[acoustics]].

senses.en: the scientific study of sound

senses.zh: 使（计划、决定或想法）正式化；使定形；使具体化
senses.en: (esp. BrE) (AmE formalize) make a plan, decision, or idea official, esp. by deciding and clearly describing all the details
examples: Final arrangements for the takeover of the company have yet to be [[formalised]].

senses.en: (usu. before noun) relating to a particular context
examples: Now We need to examine the role of [[contextual]] factors directly and in more detail.

senses.en: do sth. that has been carefully planned
examples: The job involves drawing up and [[executing]] a plan of nursing care.

senses.en: kill sb., esp. legally as a punishment
examples: Anyone caught trying to escape from that prison would be [[executed]].

senses.en: a list of the exact amounts of the ingredients that are used for making sth.
examples: The [[formulas]] for these drinks are closely guarded secrets of the company.

senses.en: a series of numbers or letters that represent a mathematical or scientific rule
examples: He developed a mathematical [[formula]] describing the distances of the planets from the Sun.

senses.en: relating to art or culture
examples: According to a famous art critic, opinion about the [[artistic]] merit of his paintings has been mixed.

senses.zh: 艺术精湛的；有艺术才华的
senses.en: good at painting, drawing, or producing beautiful things
examples: His friends are all [[artistic]] — they're painters, musicians, dancers, and writers.

senses.en: (of one's own ~) (fml.) if you do sth. of your own volition, you do it because you want to, not because you are forced to
examples: To everyone's astonishment, Helena left the company of her own [[volition]].

senses.en: (only before noun) (fml.) connected with a procedure
examples: The business of the committee was delayed by [[procedural]] difficulties.

senses.en: (fml.) having the ability to work and make decisions by yourself without any help from anyone else
examples: It is teachers' responsibility to help children become [[autonomous]] learners.

senses.en: an autonomous place or organization is free to govern or control itself
examples: Five provinces are to become [[autonomous]] regions in the new federal system of government.

senses.en: if people interact with each other, they talk to each other, work together, etc.
examples: The little girl's teacher told her mom that she [[interacted]] well with the other children.

senses.zh: （计算机程序、电视系统等）交互的，互动的
senses.en: an interactive computer program, television system, etc. allows you to communicate directly with it, and does things in reaction to your actions
examples: This is an [[interactive]] museum where children can actively manipulate the exhibits.

senses.zh: 合作的； 相互交流的
senses.en: involving talking and working together
examples: Our school encourages [[interactive]] teaching methods, such as role playing.

senses.en: the state of wanting to do or have sth. very much, esp. sth. interesting or enjoyable
examples: People were pushing each other out of the way in their [[eagerness]] to get to the front.

senses.en: the ability to understand sth.
examples: It's annoying that they don't have the least [[comprehension]] of what I'm trying to do.

senses.zh: 从字面意义来看；严格地说
senses.en: in the true or exact meaning of the word or phrase
examples: There wasn't much vegetarian food as such, although there were several types of salads.
